digest.component_or_area: store lock management and error reporting
propositions: When a compaction sweep holds the store write lock, blocked sessions receive a bare PID without identifying the holder as a sweep or indicating it is safely interruptible
The operation label and remedy text must reach lock timeout messages through an ambient contextvar mechanism without modifying acquisition call sites in compact_txn.py
Lock owner stamps must remain colon-free when carrying an optional op= field to preserve forward compatibility with older rebar versions that split on colons
The LockTimeout error message must include remedy text stating that compact-sweep holders are interruptible and data-safe to kill, but only for known interruptible operations
